remarks: Located in Hillview Estates--one of Ventura County's premier 55+ communities--this home offers the rare opportunity to own your own land with low HOA dues of just $275/month (which includes trash and cable TV). Beautifully upgraded and remodeled throughout, this home features unique design details and a warm European flair. The open living and dining area features newer luxury vinyl plank (LVP) flooring, a built-in wall-to-wall wood entertainment center, expansive built-in desk spaces with tall windows, and excellent custom storage.
